description: Rewrites high-confidence VN-style learn + school subject classroom/enrollment contexts to study + school subject.
fp_risk_note: High risk because learn is often correct. V1 only rewrites one simple clause with a whitelisted pronoun subject, learn/learns/learned or agreement-matched am/is/are learning, one bare whitelisted school subject, and an immediately following school/class/university/college location. It blocks broad learn-subject sentences, at class, determiners, about/that/from/online/with/by, lists, subordinate tails, imperatives, and broad learn/study grammar.

positive.notes: Bare learn plus whitelisted subject and required at-school location.
Third-person learns maps to studies in a classroom context.
Past learned maps to studied with an enrollment location.

positive.input: We are learning history in school.
positive.expectedCorrection: We are studying history in school.
positive.notes: Agreement-matched progressive form maps learning to studying.

positive.input: He is learning chemistry in class.
positive.expectedCorrection: He is studying chemistry in class.
positive.notes: He is learning plus a whitelisted subject and class location is in v1 scope.

negative.notes: Broad learn English without required school/class context is blocked.
Progressive learn-subject without required location is blocked.

negative.input: I learned English from my mother.
negative.expectedCorrection: I learned English from my mother.
negative.notes: From-source learning context is correct with learn.
Online learning context is out of v1 scope.

negative.input: I learned about history in school.
negative.expectedCorrection: I learned about history in school.
negative.notes: Learned about is a valid meaning and must not rewrite.

negative.input: I learned that science is interesting at school.
negative.expectedCorrection: I learned that science is interesting at school.

negative.input: I learned a lesson at school.
negative.expectedCorrection: I learned a lesson at school.

negative.notes: Adverb after learns means no immediate school-subject object.
Imperative has no whitelisted subject pronoun.
At class is explicitly not an allowed location phrase.

negative.input: I learn the English at school.
negative.expectedCorrection: I learn the English at school.
negative.notes: Determiner before the subject object is blocked.

negative.input: I learn English and math at school.
negative.expectedCorrection: I learn English and math at school.

negative.input: I learn English at school because I like it.
negative.expectedCorrection: I learn English at school because I like it.
negative.notes: Subordinate tail after the location phrase is blocked.

negative.input: I is learning English at school.
negative.expectedCorrection: I is learning English at school.
negative.notes: Progressive auxiliary must agree with the pronoun subject.

negative.input: She are learning English in class.
negative.expectedCorrection: She are learning English in class.
negative.notes: Mismatched progressive auxiliary is not corrected by this calque rule.
